about.title: What is TOTONOI THAI?
about.subtitle:
A Thai-based Wellness Community
to Rebuild Your Human Power in the AI Era
about.description:
"TOTONOI THAI CLUB" is a community for those who realize the importance of "wellness" in this overwhelming AI-dominated era, gathering in Thailand.

It is not just an information media. Through activities like saunas, retreats, and digital detoxing, it is a place to "align" yourselves and collectively strengthen the "human power" and resilience that is being lost today.

By changing our environment and connecting passionately with like-minded peers, let's overcome the coming era strongly together.
